with LA brandsShopify development cost in Los Angeles is a variable term, in today’s world, because it can be under $500 if the store is set up DIY. Or the cost can go up to $80,000+ for a fully custom enterprise build, can stay around $15,000 for a mid-sized LA business, and can even drop upto $2,000 if the professional store is small.

But of course, all these numbers are based on proximity, because the exact costings would depend on;

  • The build tier you require
  • whether you hire a freelancer or an agency,
  • how much custom development and integration work is involved, and
  • whether you’re building on standard Shopify or Shopify Plus.

And once you have sorted answers for these queries, you will understand the costing better in the upcoming section, aka the quick breakdown.
contentAfterToc:
Shopify Development Pricing in 2026: The Quick Breakdown

As far as the costing is concerned, let’s have a quick glance, before we go
into line-by-line listings:

Build Type Cost Range Typical Timeline
DIY setup (theme + self-build) $50 – $500 A few days
Professional small business build $2,000 – $5,000 2–4 weeks
Mid-market custom build $5,000 – $15,000 +4–8 weeks
Enterprise / Shopify Plus build $15,000 – $80,000 +8–16 weeks

And for your knowledge, let us mention that these ranges tend to cover development
only. They sit on top of Shopify’s own monthly platform fee, which runs from $5/month for the lightest
plan up to $2,300+/month for Plus, plus whatever you spend on apps and transaction fees.

Cost to Build a Shopify Store, Tier by Tier

DIY ($50–$500): Using a free theme, Shopify’s
no-code editor, and a Basic plan subscription, a solo founder can have a working store live within days.
This works for simple catalogs with minimal customization needs.

Professional small business build ($2,000–$5,000):
This tier typically includes a premium theme, professional setup and configuration, a handful of well-chosen
apps, and some design and copy polish. Most LA small businesses launching their first serious store land
here.

Mid-market custom build ($5,000–$15,000+): Brands
at this stage usually need theme customization beyond what a template allows, integrations with email,
reviews, or loyalty platforms, and a more developed product and content structure. This is the most common
tier for growing LA DTC brands moving past their first year.

Enterprise / Shopify Plus build ($15,000–$80,000+):
Reserved for brands with complex catalogs, multiple sales channels, custom checkout requirements, or
integrations into ERP and CRM systems. This is where Shopify Plus development cost comes in specifically,
covered in more detail below.

Shopify Agency Rates in Los Angeles

Los Angeles sits in one of the more expensive markets for hiring locally. LA-based
and broader US/Canadian agencies commonly bill in the $120–$200/hour range for Shopify development,
reflecting both higher overhead and strong local demand from the city’s dense DTC and retail-brand
ecosystem.

That said, location no longer dictates quality the way it once did. A growing
number of brands are working with hybrid teams, agencies that combine US-based strategy and account
management with experienced offshore development, landing in a blended $40–$80/hour range without a
meaningful drop in output. For LA brands trying to stretch a build budget further without sacrificing
reliability, this is usually the more efficient route.

Freelancer vs Agency Shopify Cost: Which Should You
Choose

Factor Freelancer Agency
Typical rate $15–$70/hour $40–$200/hour
Best for Small, contained tasks Full builds, integrations, and ongoing scaling
Project management Usually self-managed Included
QA and testing Often informal Structured
Risk profile Higher (single point of failure) Lower (team-based delivery)

A freelancer makes sense for something narrow, like a homepage update or a single
app integration. For a full store build, a migration, or anything touching checkout and inventory logic, the
agency model tends to produce more predictable outcomes, mainly because the cost difference isn’t just
labor; it’s the project management and QA layered on top.

Hire Shopify Developer Cost: Hourly Rates Explained

Hourly rates for Shopify developers vary widely by experience and engagement
model:

  • Junior/freelancer:
    $15–$30/hour
  • Mid-level freelancer:
    $33–$70/hour
  • US/Canada agency:
    $120–$200/hour
  • Hybrid agency (onshore strategy, offshore
    delivery): $40–$80/hour blended

The gap between a $30/hour junior developer and a $150/hour senior agency hire is
real, but it isn’t always proportional to project complexity. A simple task is genuinely cheaper when
done by a freelancer. A full build or anything affecting checkout, inventory, or revenue-critical logic is
where the agency premium usually pays for itself in fewer post-launch fixes.

Shopify Plus Development Cost

For LA brands scaling into Shopify Plus, development cost runs noticeably higher
than standard Shopify, generally $15,000 to $80,000+, depending on scope, on top of Plus’s own
$2,300+/month platform fee. Custom checkout development alone, only available on Plus, typically adds
$5,000–$15,000.

This tier is only worth the investment once a brand has a clear growth trigger
behind it, like multi-channel order volume or checkout customization needs that standard Shopify can’t
support. (For a closer look at what that scaling journey actually looks like for LA brands, see our
breakdown of how LA brands are using Shopify Plus to scale.)

Shopify Maintenance Cost

Launch is rarely the last expense, because after that comes the ongoing Shopify
maintenance cost that typically falls into two 2 different camps;

  1. $0–$100/month if it’s only about handling
    updates, bug fixes & app management yourself,
  2. $500–$2,000/month if you keep a developer on
    retainer.

However, brands that run frequent promotions, seasonal campaigns, and have some
active app integrations would be more likely to require higher end of that range to stay ahead of issues
rather than reacting to them.

What Actually Drives Your Shopify Development Cost Up or
Down

There are some factors that, because of the numbers, can go up and down.

how much custom design work is needed versus using an existing theme, how many
third-party systems (ERP, CRM, fulfillment) need to connect to the store, how organized your product content
and photography are before development starts, and how tightly the initial launch scope is defined.

Brands that launch with a focused feature set and add complexity post-launch, once
revenue justifies it, consistently spend less than those trying to build everything at once.

Choosing the Right Shopify Development Partner in Los
Angeles

Cost only tells part of the story. The bigger risk for most LA brands isn’t
overpaying, it’s choosing a partner who can’t support the store past launch. Dynamic Dreamz works with LA brands across the full range covered here, from professional small business builds to enterprise
Shopify Plus scaling, as a Shopify Platinum Partner with the team structure to handle both the build and what
comes after it.

If you’re weighing options for your own Los Angeles Shopify project, it’s
worth getting a scoped quote before deciding on an engagement model.

FAQs

How much does Shopify development cost in Los Angeles?

Most LA businesses spend between $2,000 and $15,000 for a professional Shopify
store, with enterprise Shopify Plus builds running $15,000 to $80,000 or more, depending on
complexity.

What’s the difference between hiring a freelancer vs. an
agency for Shopify development?

Freelancers cost less and suit small, contained tasks, while agencies cost more
but include project management and QA, making them the more reliable choice for full builds, migrations, or
anything touching checkout and inventory.

How much does a Shopify Plus build cost compared to standard
Shopify?

Shopify Plus development typically costs $15,000 to $80,000+, well above standard
Shopify’s $2,000–$15,000 range, reflecting the platform’s higher monthly fee and the
complexity of the builds it’s designed for.

Why do LA-based businesses sometimes pay more for Shopify
development locally?

Local LA and broader US/Canadian agencies bill $120–$200/hour due to higher
overhead and demand, while hybrid teams blending US strategy with experienced offshore development typically
run $40–$80/hour for comparable quality.

What ongoing costs should I budget for after launch?

Plan for $0–$100/month if you manage updates yourself, or
$500–$2,000/month for a developer retainer, depending on how frequently your store needs changes,
fixes, or new feature work.
